newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Q1 deficit on Maastricht basis at 1.1pct/GDP.
newsitem.headline: Spain Q1 deficit on Maastricht basis at 1.1pct/GDP.

text.p: Spain said on Wednesday its first quarter budget deficit on a national account basis --the relevant accounting measure for the Maastricht Treaty-- fell 30.1 percent over the year-ago quarter to 836.0 billion pesetas.

This puts the first quarter 1997 budget at 1.1 percent of gross domestic product, well beneath the reference value of three percent for all of 1997 in the Maastricht Treaty, according to a statement from the Economy Ministry.
Spain also said its March budget deficit on a cash basis was 660.9 billion pesetas, down 4.5 percent from March 1996. The first quarter budget deficit on a cash basis was 861.2 billion pesetas.
Later this morning, the EU Commission will present its outlook on member state's deficit and inflation.
